input.body: We are writing to request a review of a deduction of $28.40 on order DD-51152 from 7 November 2026, which was applied with the reason "missing item" for Chicken Thukpa. The order ticket for DD-51152 lists Veg Momo (Steamed) and Samosa Chaat, and does not list Chicken Thukpa [DD-51152:ticket_omits_item]. Our records also show the order was ready at 20:26 and was picked up at 20:29, three minutes later [DD-51152:pickup_handoff]. We understand the ticket shows what was ordered and prepared, and we are not able to show what was in the bag. Based on the ticket, the claimed item does not appear to have been part of this order. We kindly ask that you review the deduction and reverse it. Thank you for your time and consideration.
